name: obsidian-dita-monorepo
description: DITA reading view for Obsidian, built on a host-neutral DITA rendering core shared with the VS Code DITA Viewer.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dita-viewer/core && npm run typecheck -w obsidian-dita
scripts.test: npm test -w @dita-viewer/core && npm test -w obsidian-dita && node --test scripts/release.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run release:check
